audience: teams that collect applications, requests or reports in Cognito Forms

useCases.title: Review the latest entries on a form
useCases.text: List the forms the API key can access, then list the entries of one form view. Get one entry to read its field values.

useCases.title: Download a file uploaded to an entry
useCases.text: Get an entry to find the file id. Then get the file name, type, size and link, and the body only if you ask for it.

useCases.title: Update an entry with the right field names
useCases.text: Get the schema of a form to see its field names and choices. Then update the given field values of one entry. Fields you leave out keep their values.

useCases.title: Submit a new entry to a form
useCases.text: Create an entry on a form with the given field values. The form's notifications and workflows run as they do for a submission.

useCases.title: Close a form to new submissions
useCases.text: Set when the public link of a form accepts submissions, with a message shown while it is closed.
